verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Terraform provider or an equivalent declarative IaC tool for Google Workspace. Admin SDK, Cloud Identity API and Apps Script automation are developer building blocks for scripting, not a managed-as-code provider covering apps, groups and policies. These earn no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
